tha-ap283:1.1: Suvaṇṇabimbohanavaggo aṭṭhavīsatimo. [281. Paṇṇadāyaka.] Paṇṇasāle nisinno 'mhi paṇṇabhojanabhojano / upaviṭṭhañ ca maṃ santam upagacchi mahāisi // //
tha-ap283:2.1: Siddhattho lokapajjoto sabbalokatikicchako / tassa paṇṇaṃ mayā dinnaṃ nisinnassa paṇṇasanthare. // //
tha-ap283:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ paṇṇam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi paṇṇadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap283:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Paṇṇadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
